title: 第五章 淬血破境心藏城府不藏恶第六章 古木藏珍人心更胜山林险
lines: 黑风山脉外层，密林幽暗，夜风穿林如啸，卷起满地枯叶，沙沙声响连绵不绝，掩盖了细碎的动静，却也让林间的危机感愈发浓重。
沈砚隐于粗壮的古树干后，身躯紧贴粗糙树皮，周身气息尽数敛入肌理，呼吸绵长细微，几乎与周遭草木夜风融为一体。
他从不打无准备之仗，更不会被一时的猎杀收益冲昏头脑。方才斩杀黑风狼，他刻意留尸不处理，以妖兽血气为饵，看似被动蛰伏，实则早已掌控了整片区域的局势。
这是他十年来养成的行事本能——身处绝境，不赌运气，只赌算计。
在侯府的棋局里，他靠隐忍、分寸、借力打力破局；在这生死不由人的荒山，他靠预判、耐心、步步为营求生。
很多人以为强者的底气是一往无前的勇猛，可沈砚心底清楚，真正能走得远的强者，永远是先算生死、再动手，先留退路、再争机缘。他腹黑、善谋、擅长拿捏人心与局势，却始终守着最朴素的武道本心：不嗜杀、不妄为、不欺弱，只为自保、破局、逆天改命。
短短十数息，数道低沉的兽吼由远及近，愈发清晰。林间雾气翻涌，三道黑影从密林中窜出，速度迅猛，四肢踏地带起风声，直奔地上的黑风狼尸而去。
三头黑风狼，体型健硕，皮毛黝黑发亮，双目赤红，獠牙森白，皆是淬体四重的成熟妖兽，且彼此配合默契，显然是常年结伴觅食的狼群小队。
它们被浓郁的血气吸引，满心皆是掠食的贪婪，全然没有察觉暗处蛰伏的人类猎手。在它们的认知里，外层山林的人类武者大多谨慎胆小、实力平庸，根本不足以威胁群居妖兽。
沈砚眸光微凝，漆黑的眼底没有半分波澜，只有极致冷静的战局推演。
三头淬体四重黑风狼，单打独斗皆不足为惧，可群居联动、野性凶悍，缠斗起来极易被偷袭划伤。寻常淬体五重武者，遇到三头结伴黑风狼，大多只会避战退让，不愿无谓受伤。
但沈砚不同。
他的根基远超同阶，身法无匹，招式凝练，更精通人心与兽性的弱点。妖兽凶戾无脑，贪婪急躁，便是最大的破绽。
他不急着出手，静静看着三头黑风狼争抢狼尸，彼此撕咬低吼、互相牵制，原本默契的阵型瞬间散乱，凶性尽数被贪欲点燃，心神彻底失守。
就是此刻。
沈砚身形骤然一动，如离弦之箭窜出树荫阴影，动作轻捷无声，行云流水的流云步施展而出，瞬间拉近十数丈距离。
他没有选择正面强攻，那般太过耗力，且容易被狼群合围反扑。身躯低空掠出，顺势贴地翻转，避开正面视野，精准绕至最外侧一头黑风狼的盲区后侧。
右手凝劲，《碎石诀》全力爆发，掌风沉凝霸道，摒弃所有花哨招式，只剩纯粹的破坏力，精准轰向妖兽后颈软甲要害。
沉闷的血肉撞击声响起，力道透骨入髓。
那头黑风狼甚至来不及反应、来不及发出嘶吼，头颅筋骨瞬间碎裂，庞大的身躯直直扑倒在地，四肢抽搐两下，彻底断绝生机。
瞬杀一头，干净利落，全程不足半息。
另外两头黑风狼瞬间警觉，舍弃狼尸，齐齐转头，赤红的双目死死锁定沈砚，口中发出凶狠低吼，周身戾气暴涨，分头夹击扑杀而来。
一左一右，封锁所有闪避路线，獠牙带风，攻势凶悍，杀机凛冽。
面对两头妖兽的合围死局，沈砚面色依旧沉静，心底没有半分慌乱。
慌乱是弱者的情绪，博弈是强者的本能。
他瞬间判断出两头妖兽的攻势节奏，左侧妖兽速度更快、力道稍弱，右侧妖兽肉身更强、攻势更稳，二者一快一稳，配合刁钻，却也节奏不一、破绽分明。
沈砚脚下步伐变幻，身形诡异地横移，先避其锋芒，不与两头妖兽硬拼。流云步被他打磨至巅峰，身形飘忽不定，在狭小的林间空地辗转腾挪，两头妖兽的凶狠扑杀次次落空，锋利的獠牙与利爪只能撕碎空气、拍碎枯枝。
数招过后，两头妖兽接连落空，凶性愈发急躁，呼吸紊乱，体能快速消耗，原本整齐的夹击节奏彻底崩坏。
急躁，是所有野兽覆灭的根源。
沈砚眼底精光一闪，抓住转瞬即逝的破绽，身形骤然提速，贴身欺近右侧肉身更强的黑风狼。他不攻要害，反手精准扣住妖兽脖颈皮毛，借力翻身，重心下压。
磅礴的淬体五重巅峰气血尽数灌注臂膀，借着下坠之势，狠狠将那头黑风狼按在泥泞地面。
同时左手成掌，连续两记重拍，精准落在妖兽头颅两侧，封震气血、碎裂筋骨。
第二头妖兽，秒杀。
剩余最后一头黑风狼见状，凶戾的攻势骤然停滞，赤红的双目之中首次生出惧意。野兽本能趋利避害，接连两头同伴瞬杀，眼前这个看似清瘦的人类少年，根本不是可猎杀的猎物，而是蛰伏的恐怖猎手。
它心生退意，夹着尾巴转身便逃。
可沈砚既然出手，便绝不会给对手任何退路。
“既然来了，便留下吧。”
content_en:
In the outer layer of the Black Wind Mountains, the dense forest is dark, and the night wind roars through the forest, picking up dead leaves all over the ground. The rustling sound is continuous, covering up the small movements, but it also makes the sense of crisis in the forest more intense.
Shen Yan was hidden behind a thick ancient tree trunk, his body clinging to the rough bark, and all the breath around him was absorbed into the texture. His breathing was long and subtle, almost blending into the night breeze of the surrounding vegetation.
He never fights an unprepared battle, and he never gets carried away by the temporary gains from hunting. He had just killed the Black Wind Wolf, but he deliberately left the body undisposed of, using the monster's blood as bait. It seemed like he was passively dormant, but in fact he had already controlled the situation in the entire area.
This is the instinct he has developed over the past ten years - when in desperate situations, he does not gamble on luck, only on calculation.
In the chess game in the Hou Mansion, he relies on forbearance, propriety, and the use of force to break the game; in this barren mountain where life and death are not up to anyone, he relies on prediction, patience, and step by step to survive.
Many people think that the confidence of a strong man lies in his indomitable courage, but Shen Yan knows in his heart that a truly strong man who can go far always calculates life and death before taking action, leaves a way out first, and then fights for opportunities. He is sinister, good at scheming, and is good at manipulating people's hearts and situations, but he always adheres to the simplest martial arts heart: not bloodthirsty, not reckless, not bullying, but only to protect himself, break the situation, and change his destiny.
In just ten breaths, several low beast roars became clearer and clearer from far to near. The mist in the forest surged, and three black shadows sprang out from the dense forest. They were fast and furious, making a sound of wind as they stepped on their limbs, and headed straight for the black wind wolf corpse on the ground.
The three black wind wolves have a muscular body, dark and shiny fur, red eyes, and white tusks. They are all mature monster beasts of the fourth level of body tempering, and they cooperate with each other tacitly. They are obviously a wolf pack that hunts together all year round.
They were attracted by the rich blood, filled with the greed of predators, and were completely unaware of the human hunters lurking in the dark. In their understanding, most of the human warriors in the outer mountains and forests are cautious, timid, and mediocre in strength, and are not enough to threaten the monster beasts living in groups.
Shen Yan's eyes were slightly focused, and there was no wave in his dark eyes, only an extremely calm deduction of the battle situation.
The three tempered four-level black wind wolves are not to be feared when fighting alone. They can live in groups and are wild and ferocious. They can easily be scratched by sneak attacks during a fight. Ordinary fifth-level body-tempering warriors, when encountering three black wind wolves accompanied by three, would mostly avoid fighting and give in, not wanting to be hurt unnecessarily.
But Shen Yan is different.
His foundation far exceeds those of the same level, his physical skills are unparalleled, his moves are concise, and he is even more proficient in the weaknesses of human nature and animal nature. The monsters are cruel and brainless, greedy and impatient, which is the biggest flaw.
He was not in a hurry to take action, and quietly watched the three black wind wolves fighting for the wolf carcass, biting and growling at each other, and restraining each other. The originally tacit formation was instantly scattered, their ferocity was ignited by greed, and their mind was completely lost.
This is the moment.
Shen Yan's figure suddenly moved, like an arrow from a string, darting out of the shadow of a tree. His movement was light and silent, and he performed a flowing cloud step, instantly closing the distance of more than ten feet.
He did not choose to attack head-on, as that would be too energy-consuming and could easily lead to a counterattack by the wolves. The body flew out at a low altitude, flipped close to the ground, avoided the front view, and accurately circled behind the blind spot of the black wind wolf on the outermost side.
Condensing strength in his right hand, the "Gravel Technique" explodes with full force, the palm wind is calm and domineering, abandoning all fancy moves, leaving only pure destructive power, accurately hitting the soft armor on the back of the monster's neck.
"Bang!"
The dull sound of flesh and blood colliding sounded, and the force penetrated the bones and entered the marrow.
The black wind wolf didn't even have time to react or roar. His skull and bones instantly shattered, and his huge body fell straight to the ground. His limbs twitched twice, completely cutting off his life.
Kill one instantly, cleanly, and the whole process takes less than half a breath.
The other two black wind wolves were instantly alert, abandoned the wolf carcass, and turned their heads together. Their red eyes were locked on Shen Yan, and they roared fiercely. The rage around them surged, and they split up to attack and kill him.
One on the left and one on the right, blocking all evasion routes, fangs leading to the wind, the attack is fierce, and the murderous intention is fierce.
Facing the deadly encirclement between the two demonic beasts, Shen Yan's expression remained calm, and there was no trace of panic in his heart.
Panic is the emotion of the weak, and gaming is the instinct of the strong.
He instantly judged the offensive rhythm of the two demonic beasts. The demonic beast on the left was faster and weaker, while the demonic beast on the right was physically stronger and had a more stable attack. One was fast and the other was steady. Their cooperation was tricky, but they also had different rhythms and obvious flaws.
The steps under Shen Yan's feet changed, and his body moved sideways strangely, trying to avoid its sharp edge first and not to fight head-on with the two monsters. Liuyunbu was polished to its peak by him, and his figure was erratic, moving around in the small forest clearing. The ferocious attacks of the two monster beasts failed time and time again. The sharp fangs and claws could only tear the air and smash dead branches.
After several moves, the two monster beasts failed one after another. Their ferocity became more and more impatient, their breathing was disordered, their physical energy was consumed rapidly, and the originally neat rhythm of the pincer attack completely collapsed.
Impatience is the root of the downfall of all beasts.
Shen Yan's eyes flashed, and he caught the fleeting flaw. He suddenly accelerated his body and bullied the Black Wind Wolf, who was physically stronger on the right side. He did not attack the vital points, but accurately grasped the fur of the monster's neck with his backhand, used the force to turn over, and pressed down his center of gravity.
The majestic fifth-level body-tempering peak energy and blood poured into his arms, and with the force of his fall, he pressed the black wind wolf to the muddy ground.
At the same time, his left hand formed a palm, and he struck twice in succession, landing accurately on both sides of the monster's head, sealing the energy and blood and shattering the muscles and bones.
The second monster is killed instantly.
When the last remaining black wind wolf saw this, its ferocious offensive suddenly stopped, and fear appeared in its red eyes for the first time. The instinct of wild beasts is to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages, and the two companions were instantly killed in succession. The seemingly thin human boy in front of him was not a huntable prey at all, but a dormant and terrifying hunter.
It wanted to retreat, turned around and ran away with its tail between its legs.
But now that Shen Yan takes action, he will never give his opponent any way out.
"Now that you're here, stay."
title_en: Chapter 5: Tempering blood and breaking through the realm, the heart hides no evil in the city. Chapter 6: Treasures hidden in ancient trees, the heart is more dangerous than the mountains and forests.
